title: Burger King Brand Partners Guidelines
slide_intent: Introduce the guide in the identity it governs so readers encounter its character before its rules.
strategic_value: Oversized rounded lettering and warm colors can establish Burger King’s food-led personality immediately.
demonstration: Orange and red title lines occupy a dark brown field; small publication and distribution notices sit at the edges.
practical_value: Use the cover to compare how a guide can demonstrate its own typography and palette.

content_islands.name: Title
content_islands.spec: Place the large three-line title at upper left with the brand name orange and remaining lines red.

content_islands.name: Publication notices
content_islands.spec: Retain the small guide label above and the copyright and internal-distribution notes along the bottom.

reference_purposes.Expression: The cover applies rounded display lettering and a warm three-color treatment.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The cover identifies the document as for authorized internal recipients and prohibits external distribution.
